text: This app needs to store data that survives a restart. Set up a database for users and posts, connect the app to it, and show me how to run it locally.
Add persistence to this project. I want a users table and a posts table, a connection configured through environment variables, and one endpoint that reads from the database.
Right now everything is in memory and I lose it on reload. Move the data into a real database and wire up the connection.
Add a data access layer for users and posts. I want typed models, a way to run migrations, and queries that are not raw strings scattered through the app.
Set up schema definitions for a users table and a posts table with a foreign key between them, plus migration tooling so I can evolve the schema later.
I need models and queries for this project. Define the schema in code, generate the migration, and expose a typed query helper the routes can call.
Add sign up and sign in to this app. Users should be able to create an account, log in, log out, and hit a route that only works when they are logged in.
I need authentication and sessions here. Protect the dashboard route so anonymous visitors are redirected, and keep the user signed in across reloads.
Set up user accounts for this project, including login, logout, and a way to read the current user on the server.
Get this project ready to deploy. Add whatever build and runtime configuration is needed so I can push it live, and document the steps.
I want this running on the public internet. Set up the deployment configuration and tell me what to run to ship it.
Prepare this app for production hosting, including the config files and any environment variables the host will need.
The app needs to send a welcome email when someone signs up. Wire up email sending and add the template.
Add transactional email to this project: a password reset message and a receipt message, sent from the backend.
I need to email users from this app. Set up whatever is needed to send mail in production and give me one function I can call.
Add paid subscriptions to this app. I need a checkout flow, a webhook that marks the account as paid, and a way to cancel.
I want to charge users for a monthly plan. Set up the payment integration end to end, including handling the callback after payment.
Wire up billing for this project so a visitor can buy a plan and the backend learns about it.
This endpoint does slow work inline and times out. Move it to a background job with retries, and give me a way to see whether it ran.
Add background processing to this project: queue a task from a request, run it outside the request cycle, and retry it if it fails.
I need deferred and scheduled work here. Set up the job runner and add one recurring task plus one on-demand task.
This route recomputes an expensive result on every request. Add caching with a sensible expiry and a way to invalidate it.
Add a cache layer to this project so repeated reads are cheap. It should survive a process restart.
Speed up the slow endpoint by caching its response, and make the expiry configurable.
Let users upload an avatar image. Store the file somewhere durable and save the URL on the user record.
Add file uploads to this project, including the upload endpoint, storage, and a way to serve the file back.
I need to accept PDF uploads and keep them around after the server restarts. Set up storage and the upload flow.
I want to know when this app throws in production. Set up error reporting with stack traces and a test error I can trigger.
Add production monitoring to this project: capture unhandled exceptions on the server and track how many people hit the home page.
Give this app visibility once it is live. I need crash reports and basic usage numbers.
